name: tft153_st77916
title: Round 1.53-inch TFT on an ST77916
description: A round 360x360 display module on QSPI, marked TFT 1.53 1.0. Not a board of its own: a project wires it to one.

lcd.notes: The glass is marked T150XV-C16-04. The size in mm is that of the ST77916 example of esp32-component-dgx-lvgl, not measured.

aliexpress.source: Anton: a listing of a 1.5-inch 360x360 ST77916 module, with VAT, before duty

picture.by: Anton: hello_lvgl on esp32s3_devkit with the pins of the bench, ESP-IDF 6.1, DGX 0.10.3
picture.notes: These pins are the IO MUX set of SPI2: under ESP-IDF 6.1 they stay dark with a DGX older than 0.10.3.

levels.source: A panel of 3.3 V logic. The supply of the module on the bench is not written down.
